summary: Frontend-only testing of AssetNova footer/legal update. All 9 requested checks passed: footer renders on all public + authenticated pages with correct data-testids, copyright shows '© 2026 AssetNova Energy. All rights reserved. AssetNova™ is a product of AssetNova Energy™' (no ® symbol anywhere), all 4 footer links (Privacy/Terms/Trademark/Contact) route to correct paths and render corresponding pages with expected data-testids, Trademark page contains verbatim legal text and mailto:info@assetnovaenergy.com link, footer-version continues to show 'v1.0 · READY' on public pages and 'v1.0 · DEMO' on authenticated dashboard, and mobile 375px viewport renders footer cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: footer-copyright text has no space between 'reserved.' and 'AssetNova™' when the inline span wraps on the same line in wide viewport (visual output shows 'reserved.AssetNova™'). Consider adding a leading space or bullet separator in the span for improved readability. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer/legal pages verified end-to-end via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Optional cosmetic nit: minor missing space in footer copyright between '.All rights reserved.' and 'AssetNova™' when text collapses on same line.
